sentences.zh: 天成三年春正月戊申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In spring, first month of Tiancheng 3, on the wushen new moon the Emperor held audience at the Chongyuan Hall and received congratulations; guards and escort followed the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the first month of Tiancheng 3 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Chongyuan Hall with the usual guard.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，前河陽節度使、檢校太傅、兼侍中孔以太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On xinhai, former Heyang military commissioner, Grand Guardian by inspection, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief Kong was made Grand Preceptor emeritus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Kong Xun of Heyang retired as grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔取今月十七日幸鄴都。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered that on the seventeenth of this month the Emperor should visit Ye capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Mingzong ordered a visit to Ye capital on the seventeenth.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以國子祭酒朱守素卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On jiayin, because Director of the National University Zhu Shousu had died, court attendance was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin court was canceled for the death of national university director Zhu Shousu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以鎮南軍節度使袁建豐卒廢朝，詔贈太尉。

translations.literal: On bingchen, because Zhennan Army military commissioner Yuan Jianfeng had died, court was suspended; an edict posthumously gave Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen court was canceled for Yuan Jianfeng of Zhennan and he was posthumously made grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔曰：「朕聞堯、舜有恤刑之典，貴務好生；

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict said: "We have heard that Yao and Shun had statutes of compassionate punishment, valuing the work of cherishing life;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict cited Yao and Shun's compassionate punishment and cherishing life;

sentences.zh: 禹、湯申罪己之言，庶明知過。

translations.literal: Yu and Tang voiced words of confessing faults, so the multitude might clearly know transgression.
translations.idiomatic: and Yu and Tang's confessions of fault so subjects might know their errors.

sentences.zh: 今月十七日，據巡檢軍使渾公兒口奏稱，有百姓二人，以竹竿習戰鬥之事。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth of this month, according to a verbal memorial from patrol-inspection army commissioner Hun Gong'er, two commoners were practicing combat with bamboo poles.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth Hun Gong'er reported two commoners practicing pole-fighting.

sentences.zh: 朕初聞奏報，實所不容，率爾傳宣，令付石敬瑭處置。

translations.literal: When We first heard the memorial We truly could not tolerate it and forthwith passed word ordering them given to Shi Jingtang for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong first ordered Shi Jingtang to punish them.

sentences.zh: 今旦重誨敷奏，方知悉是幼童為戲，載聆讜議，方覺失刑，循揣再三，愧惕非一。

translations.literal: This morning Chonghui presented the full report and We then learned it was entirely small children at play; hearing loyal remonstrance, We then realized wrongful punishment—weighed it again and again, shame and fear beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghui's morning report showed only children at play; Mingzong felt deeply ashamed of wrongful punishment.

sentences.zh: 亦以渾公兒誑誣頗甚，石敬瑭詳覆稍乖，致人枉法而殂，處朕有過之地。

translations.literal: Also Hun Gong'er deceived and slandered to a great degree; Shi Jingtang's detailed review was slightly off, causing men to die by wrongful law and putting Us in a place of fault.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Gong'er had deceived him and Shi Jingtang's review had erred, putting innocent men to death and Mingzong at fault.

sentences.zh: 今減常膳十日，以謝幽冤。

translations.literal: Now We reduce Our regular meals ten days to apologize to the wronged shades.
translations.idiomatic: He cut his meals ten days to atone for the dead.

sentences.zh: 其石敬瑭是朕懿親，合施極諫，既茲錯誤，宜示省循，可罰一月俸。

translations.literal: Shi Jingtang is Our close kin and ought to offer extreme remonstrance; since this error, he should be shown reflection and may be fined one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang, as kin, should have remonstrated; he was fined one month's salary.

sentences.zh: 渾公兒決脊杖二十，仍銷在身職銜，配流登州。

translations.literal: Hun Gong'er was sentenced to twenty strokes of the cudgel on the spine, his active office title still erased, and banished to Deng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hun Gong'er was given twenty strokes, stripped of rank, and exiled to Deng.

sentences.zh: 小兒骨肉，賜絹五十匹、粟麥各百石，便令如法埋葬。

translations.literal: The children's kin were given fifty bolts of silk and one hundred piculs each of grain and wheat, and forthwith ordered buried according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Their families received fifty bolts of silk and one hundred piculs each of grain and wheat for lawful burial.

sentences.zh: 兼此後在朝及諸道州府，凡有極刑，並須子細裁遣，不得因循。

translations.literal: Moreover hereafter at court and in every circuit and prefecture, wherever there is extreme punishment, all must carefully decide and dispatch—there must be no lax following of precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Court and circuits were ordered to judge capital cases carefully, without lax precedent.

sentences.zh: 」百僚進表稱賀。

translations.literal: " The hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: " Officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書門下奏，國子祭酒，望令宰相兼判。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: the Director of the National University should be made concurrent with a chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the secretariat asked that a chief minister also judge the national university.

sentences.zh: 乃詔崔協判之。

translations.literal: Then an edict ordered Cui Xie to judge it.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong put Cui Xie in charge.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載原奏云：祭酒之資，曆朝所貴，爰從近代，不重此官。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 records the original memorial: the qualifications of the university director have been prized by every dynasty; only from recent times has this office not been honored.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 quotes the memorial: the university director had been prized in every dynasty but lately neglected.

sentences.zh: 況屬聖朝，方勤庶政，須宏雅道，以振時風。

translations.literal: Moreover in this sagely dynasty, while civil affairs are diligently pursued, the elegant Way must be enlarged to revive the manners of the age.
translations.idiomatic: The court should revive elegant learning to set the tone of the age.

sentences.zh: 望令宰臣一員，兼判國子祭酒。）〉

translations.literal: We hope one chief minister may concurrently judge the Director of the National University.)〉
translations.idiomatic: It asked one chief minister to judge the national university concurrently.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前潞州節度使毛璋為右金吾上將軍，以左驍衛上將軍華溫琪為右金吾大將軍，以春州刺史張虔釗為鄭州防禦使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, former Luzhou military commissioner Mao Zhang was made senior general of the Right Gold Spears; Left Majestic Cavalry senior general Hua Wenqi was made grand general of the Right Gold Spears; Chun prefect Zhang Qianzhao was made Zhengzhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Mao Zhang became right gold spears senior general, Hua Wenqi right gold spears grand general, and Zhang Qianzhao Zheng defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 契丹方陷平州。

translations.literal: The Khitan were then taking Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan were besieging Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔應廟諱文字，隻避正文，其偏旁文字，不用虧缺點畫。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict said: for taboo characters in ancestral temples, only the main text is to be avoided; for component characters, omitting strokes or dots is not required.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Mingzong ordered temple taboo to apply only to full characters, not partial components.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使禿汭悲梅老等貢獻，帝遣指揮使奔托山押國信賜契丹王妻。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys Tutu'ni Beimei Lao and others with tribute; the Emperor sent commander Bentuo Shan to escort the state letter and bestow gifts on the Khitan king's consort.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys presented tribute and Mingzong sent Bentuo Shan with imperial gifts for the Khitan queen.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以隨駕馬軍都指揮使、富州刺史康義誠兼領鎮南軍節度使；

translations.literal: On wuchen, the accompanying horse-army commander-in-chief and Fu prefect Kang Yicheng was given concurrent Zhennan Army military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Kang Yicheng of the escort horse army became Zhennan commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以隨駕步軍都指揮使、潮州刺史楊漢章遙領寧國軍節度使。

translations.literal: the accompanying foot-army commander-in-chief and Chaozhou prefect Yang Hanzhang was given titular Ningguo Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: and Yang Hanzhang of the escort foot army received titular Ningguo commissionership.

sentences.zh: 中書上言：「舊制，遇二月十五日玄元皇帝降聖節，休假三日。

translations.literal: The Secretariat reported: "By old rule, on the fifteenth day of the second month, the Mysterious Origin Emperor's birthday, there were three days of leave.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat said the old rule gave three days' leave on the fifteenth of the second month for the Mysterious Origin Emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 準會昌元年二月敕，休假一日，請準近敕。

translations.literal: According to the second-month edict of Huichang year 1, leave was one day; we ask to follow the recent edict.
translations.idiomatic: Huichang precedent allowed one day; it asked to follow the recent edict instead.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃伊埒雅遜等六人、回鶻米裏都督等四人，並授歸德、懷遠將軍，放還蕃。

translations.literal: Six Tibetans including Yilieyaxun and four Uyghurs including the Milijidu were all given Guiding and Huaiyuan general, and released to their lands.
translations.idiomatic: Six Tibetans and four Uyghurs were made Guiding and Huaiyuan generals and sent home.

sentences.zh: 庚午，冊贈故瀛州刺史李嗣頵為太尉。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the late Ying prefect Li Siyin was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the late Li Siyin of Ying was posthumously enfeoffed grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬申，冊贈故皇子檢校司空從諲為太保。

translations.literal: On renshen, the late prince, Inspector-in-Chief of Works Congyin, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Prince Congyin was posthumously enfeoffed grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，製以楚國夫人曹氏為淑妃，以韓國夫人王氏為德妃，仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict made Lady Cao of Chu state Shufei and Lady Wang of Han state Defei, and still ordered the relevant offices to choose a day for enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lady Cao became Shufei and Lady Wang Defei, with enfeoffment days to be set.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑朔，有司上言，太陽合虧，既而有雲不見，群官表賀。

translations.literal: Second month, dingchou new moon: the relevant offices reported that the sun should be eclipsed; then clouds appeared and it was not seen, and the officials congratulated with memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou new moon of the second month officials reported an eclipse, but clouds hid it and they congratulated.

sentences.zh: 詔巡幸鄴都宜停。

translations.literal: An edict said the tour to Ye capital should stop.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong canceled the Ye capital tour.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，偽吳楊溥遣使貢獻，賀誅朱守殷。

translations.literal: On gengchen, false Wu's Yang Pu sent envoys with tribute, congratulating the execution of Zhu Shouyin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Yang Pu of false Wu sent tribute envoys congratulating Zhu Shouyin's execution.

sentences.zh: 帝以荊南拒命，通連淮夷，不納其使，遣還。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Jingnan had refused orders and communicated with the Huai barbarians, did not receive their envoys and sent them back.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong refused the envoys because Jingnan had defied orders and allied with Huainan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以光祿卿韋寂卒廢朝，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On renwu, because Director of the Imperial Table Wei Ji had died, court was suspended; he was posthumously given Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu court was canceled for Wei Ji and he was posthumously made rites minister.

sentences.zh: 癸未，工部尚書盧文紀貶石州司馬，員外安置。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Minister of Works Lu Wengi was demoted to Shizhou vice prefect, extra-status placement.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Lu Wengi was demoted to Shizhou vice prefect on extra status.

sentences.zh: 文紀私諱「業」，時新除於鄴為工部郎中。

translations.literal: Wengi's private taboo was "Ye"; at the time Yu Ye of Ye had newly been made Bureau of Works bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: Wengi's taboo was Ye; Yu Ye had just been made works bureau director at Ye.

sentences.zh: 舊例，僚屬名與長官諱同，或改其任。

translations.literal: By old precedent, when a subordinate's name matched the superior's taboo, his post might be changed.
translations.idiomatic: Precedent allowed changing a post when a subordinate's name matched the chief's taboo.

sentences.zh: 文紀素與宰相崔協有隙，故中書未議改官。

translations.literal: Wengi had long been at odds with chief minister Cui Xie, so the Secretariat did not discuss changing the office.
translations.idiomatic: Wengi feuded with Cui Xie, so the secretariat did not change Yu Ye's post.

sentences.zh: 於鄴授官之後，文紀自請連假。

translations.literal: After Yu Ye received his appointment, Wengi himself asked for continuous leave.
translations.idiomatic: After Yu Ye took office Wengi asked for extended leave.

sentences.zh: 鄴尋就位，及差延州官告使副未行，文紀參告，且言侯鄴回日終請換曹，鄴其夕遂自經而死，故文紀貶官。

translations.literal: Yu Ye soon took his post; when the deputy envoy for Yanzhou commission documents had not yet departed, Wengi attended the announcement and said he would finally ask to change bureau when Yu Ye returned—Yu Ye that evening hanged himself, hence Wengi was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Ye took post; before the Yanzhou commission envoy left, Wengi attended his announcement and promised to change bureaus when Yu Ye returned—Yu Ye hanged himself that night, so Wengi was demoted.

sentences.zh: 以倉部郎中何澤為吏部郎中，獎伏閣諫巡幸鄴都也。

translations.literal: Bureau of Revenue bureau director He Ze was made Bureau of Personnel bureau director, rewarding his remonstrance at the privy gate against touring Ye capital.
translations.idiomatic: He Ze was promoted to personnel bureau director for remonstrating against the Ye tour.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，天德軍節度使郭承豐加檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Tiande Army military commissioner Guo Chengfeng was given Inspector-in-Chief of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Guo Chengfeng of Tiande received inspector grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以山南西道節度使張筠為左驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Zhang Yun was made Left Majestic Cavalry senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhang Yun of Shannan West became left majestic cavalry senior general.

sentences.zh: 詔中外群臣父母亡沒者，並與追封贈。

translations.literal: An edict said that wherever civil and military officials' parents had died, posthumous enfeoffment and gifts should all be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered posthumous honors for deceased parents of all officials.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以禮部尚書崔貽孫卒輟朝。

translations.literal: On guisi, because Minister of Rites Cui Yisun had died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi court was canceled for Cui Yisun.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以吐渾寧朔、奉化兩府都知兵馬使李紹魯為吐渾寧朔府都督。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Tuhun Ningshuo and Fenghua two prefectures' overseer of horse and foot Li Shaolu was made Tuhun Ningshuo prefecture protector-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Shaolu became Tuhun Ningshuo protector-general.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以樞密使兼東都留守孔循為許州節度使兼東都留守，鄧州節度使高行珪移鎮安州，應州節度使李從璋移鎮滑州，滑州節度使盧文進移鎮鄧州。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Privy Commissioner and concurrent Eastern Capital regent Kong Xun was made Xu prefecture military commissioner and concurrent Eastern Capital regent; Deng prefecture military commissioner Gao Xinggui moved to An; Ying prefecture military commissioner Li Congzhang moved to Hua; Hua prefecture military commissioner Lu Wenjin moved to Deng.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Kong Xun became Xu commissioner while keeping Luoyang regency; Gao Xinggui moved to An, Li Congzhang to Hua, and Lu Wenjin to Deng.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以責授檀州刺史劉訓為右龍武大將軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou, demoted Tan prefecture military commissioner Liu Xun was made senior general of the Right Dragon Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Liu Xun of Tan became right dragon martial senior general.

sentences.zh: 己亥，回鶻可汗仁喻遣都督李阿爾珊等貢獻。

translations.literal: On jihai, Uyghur khan Renyu sent commissioner Li A'ershan and others with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Uyghur Khan Renyu sent Li A'ershan with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以左金吾大將軍羅周敬為同州節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin, Left Gold Spears grand general Luo Zhoujing was made Tong prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Luo Zhoujing became Tong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以威塞軍節度使張廷裕卒廢朝，詔贈太保。

translations.literal: On jiachen, because Weisai Army military commissioner Zhang Tingyu had died, court was suspended; an edict posthumously gave Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen court was canceled for Zhang Tingyu of Weisai and he was posthumously made grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 以耀州團練使孫嶽為閬州團練使，以左監門上將軍高允貞為右金吾衛大將軍，以右金吾衛大將軍華溫琪為左金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Yao prefecture training commissioner Sun Yue was made Langzhou training commissioner; Left Gate senior general Gao Yunzhen was made Right Gold Spears Guard grand general; Right Gold Spears Guard grand general Hua Wenqi was made Left Gold Spears Guard grand general.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yue moved from Yao to Lang training commissioner; Gao Yunzhen became right gold spears grand general and Hua Wenqi left gold spears grand general.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未朔，以久雨，詔文武百辟極言時政得失。

translations.literal: Third month, dingwei new moon: because of long rain, an edict ordered civil and military officials to speak freely on gains and losses in current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the third month long rains led Mingzong to invite open criticism of policy.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以邢州節度使王景戡為華州節度使，以前北京副留守李從溫為邢州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Xing prefecture military commissioner Wang Jingzhan was made Hua prefecture military commissioner; former northern capital vice regent Li Congwen was made Xing prefecture military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wang Jingzhan became Hua commissioner and Li Congwen Xing commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，以宰臣鄭玨為開府儀同三司、左僕射致仕，加食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: On jiwei, chief minister Zheng Jue was given Kaifu Yitong Sansi and retired as Left Vice Director, with five hundred added household fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zheng Jue received Kaifu Yitong, retired as left vice director, and gained five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前復州刺史翟章為新州威塞軍留後。

translations.literal: On gengshen, former Fu prefecture military commissioner Zhai Zhang was made Xinzhou Weisai Army regent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhai Zhang became Xin Weisai regent.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「孟夏薦饗，合宰相行事，在朝隻有宰相二員，今東都留守孔循帶平章事，宜令攝太尉行事。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "In early summer the seasonal offering should be performed by a chief minister; at court there are only two chief ministers; now Eastern Capital regent Kong Xun holds concurrent Grand Councillor and should be ordered to act as Grand Marshal in the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat said early-summer offerings required a chief minister and asked Kong Xun, as Luoyang regent with grand councillor rank, to act as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 」孔循稱：「使相有戎機，不司祠祭重事。

translations.literal: " Kong Xun said: "A commissioner-general has military urgency and does not administer weighty sacrificial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " Kong Xun refused, saying commissioners had military duties and should not run major sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以前鎮州節度使王建立為右僕射兼中書侍郎、平章事、集賢殿大學士、判三司。

translations.literal: " On guihai, former Zhen prefecture military commissioner Wang Jianli was made Right Vice Director with concurrent Secretariat Vice Director, Grand Councillor, Jixian Hall Grand Academician, and commissioner of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai Wang Jianli became right vice director, grand councillor, Jixian grand academician, and Three Offices commissioner.

sentences.zh: 西方鄴上言，收復歸州。

translations.literal: Xi Fangye memorialized that Gui prefecture had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Fangye reported recovering Gui prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以前鄭州刺史楊漢賓為洋州武定軍留後。

translations.literal: Former Zheng prefecture military commissioner Yang Hanbin was made Yangzhou Wuding Army regent.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hanbin of Zheng became Yang Wuding regent.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前彰國軍節度副使陳皋為鳳州武興軍留後，以前蔡州刺史孫漢韶為應州彰國軍留後，以宣徽南院使範延光為樞密使，以宣徽北院使、判三司張延朗為宣徽南院使，以前冀州刺史婁繼英為耀州團練使，以懷州刺史張廷蘊為金州防禦使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, former Zhangguo Army vice commissioner Chen Gao was made Fengzhou Wuxing Army regent; former Cai prefecture military commissioner Sun Hanzhao was made Yingzhou Zhangguo Army regent; Southern Palace privy commissioner Fan Yanguang was made Privy Commissioner; Northern Palace privy commissioner and Three Offices commissioner Zhang Yanlang was made Southern Palace privy commissioner; former Ji prefecture military commissioner Lou Jiying was made Yao training commissioner; Huai prefecture military commissioner Zhang Tingyun was made Jin defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Chen Gao became Feng Wuxing regent, Sun Hanzhao Ying Zhangguo regent, Fan Yanguang privy commissioner, Zhang Yanlang southern privy commissioner, Lou Jiying Yao training commissioner, and Zhang Tingyun Jin defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命範延光權知鎮州軍府事。

translations.literal: On jisi, Fan Yanguang was ordered to act as regent of Zhen prefecture military headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Fan Yanguang was made acting regent at Zhen.

sentences.zh: 西方鄴奏，於歸州殺敗荊南賊軍數千人。

translations.literal: Xi Fangye memorialized that at Gui prefecture several thousand Jingnan rebel troops were killed and defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Fangye reported killing thousands of Jingnan rebels at Gui.

sentences.zh: 時有太白山道士解元龜自西川至，對於便殿，稱年一百一歲。

translations.literal: At the time the Taibai Mountain Daoist Jie Yuan'gui came from Sichuan, was received in the informal hall, and claimed to be one hundred eleven years old.
translations.idiomatic: A Taibai Mountain Daoist, Jie Yuan'gui, came from Sichuan, met Mingzong informally, and claimed to be 111.

sentences.zh: 既而上表乞西都留守兼西川製置使，要修西京宮闕。

translations.literal: Soon he submitted a memorial begging for Western Capital regent with concurrent Sichuan commissioner and demanding repair of the western capital palace.
translations.idiomatic: He then asked to be western capital regent and Sichuan commissioner to repair the western palace.

sentences.zh: 帝謂侍臣曰：「此人老耄，自遠來朝，方期別有異見，反為身名，甚可笑也。

translations.literal: The Emperor told attendants: "This man is aged; coming from afar to court, We expected some special insight—instead he seeks personal fame, which is quite laughable.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong told his attendants the old man had come far yet sought only office and fame.

sentences.zh: 」賜號為知白先生，賜紫，放歸山。

translations.literal: " He was given the style-name Master Know-White, given purple robe, and released to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: " He was titled Master Know-White, given purple, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，冊回鶻可汗仁喻為順化可汗。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Uyghur khan Renyu was enfeoffed as Shunhua khan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Uyghur Khan Renyu was enfeoffed Shunhua khan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，以汴州節度使石敬瑭為鄴都留守，充天雄軍節度使，加同平章事；

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuyin: Bian prefecture military commissioner Shi Jingtang was made Ye capital regent, filling Tianxiong Army military commissioner, with added concurrent Grand Councillor;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Shi Jingtang of Bian became Ye regent and Tianxiong commissioner with grand councillor rank;

sentences.zh: 以樞密使、權知鎮州軍府事、檢校太保範延光為鎮州節度使兼北面水陸轉運使；

translations.literal: Privy Commissioner, acting regent of Zhen military headquarters, and Inspector Grand Guardian Fan Yanguang was made Zhen prefecture military commissioner with concurrent northern land-and-water transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang became Zhen commissioner and northern transport commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以司農卿鄭繢為太僕卿。

translations.literal: Director of the Directorate of Agriculture Zheng Hui was made Director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Hui moved from agriculture director to imperial stud director.

sentences.zh: 壬午，夔州節度使、東南面副招討使西方鄴加檢校太保。

translations.literal: On renwu, Kuizhou military commissioner and southeastern deputy campaign commissioner Xi Fangye was given Inspector Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Xi Fangye of Kuizhou received inspector grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇第三女石氏封永寧公主，第十三女趙氏封興平公主，仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Emperor's third daughter Lady Shi was enfeoffed Princess Yongning and the thirteenth daughter Lady Zhao Princess Xingping; the relevant offices were still ordered to choose days for enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Princess Yongning was enfeoffed to Lady Shi and Princess Xingping to Lady Zhao, with enfeoffment days to be set.

sentences.zh: 幽州上言，契丹有書求樂器。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan had sent a letter requesting musical instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou reported the Khitan sought musical instruments.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，達靼遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Tatabi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Tatabi sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 以隨駕馬軍都指揮使康義誠為侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: The accompanying horse-army commander-in-chief Kang Yicheng was made commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard personal army horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Yicheng became commander of the palace guard horse and foot.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，樞密使安重誨兼河南尹；

translations.literal: On bingxu, Privy Commissioner An Chonghui was additionally made Henan intendant;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu An Chonghui also became Henan intendant;

sentences.zh: 以皇子河南尹、判六軍諸衛事從厚為汴州節度使，判六軍如故。

translations.literal: the prince, Henan intendant and judge of the Six Armies and all guards Conghou, was made Bian prefecture military commissioner, judging the Six Armies as before.
translations.idiomatic: and Prince Conghou of Henan became Bian commissioner while keeping the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復州奏，湖南大破淮賊於道人磯。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Fu prefecture memorialized that Hunan had greatly defeated Huainan rebels at Daorenji.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Fu reported Hunan had routed Huainan rebels at Daoren Ford.

sentences.zh: 以西川馬步軍都指揮使趙廷隱兼漢州刺史，從孟知祥之請也。

translations.literal: Sichuan horse-and-foot commander-in-chief Zhao Tingyin was given concurrent Han prefecture military commissioner, following Meng Zhixiang's request.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tingyin was made Han commissioner at Meng Zhixiang's request.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《九國誌·趙廷隱傳》：知祥至蜀，康延孝陷漢州，遣廷隱率兵擊破之，擒延孝，檻送闕下。

translations.literal: (The 《Nine Kingdoms Annals · Biography of Zhao Tingyin》: When Zhixiang reached Shu, Kang Yanxiao took Han prefecture; he sent Tingyin leading troops to defeat him, captured Yanxiao, and sent him in a cangue to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Nine Kingdoms Annals · Biography of Zhao Tingyin》 says when Meng Zhixiang reached Shu, Kang Yanxiao seized Han; Zhao Tingyin defeated and caged him for the capital.

sentences.zh: 知祥奏加檢校司空、漢州刺史，遂留屯成都。）〉

translations.literal: Zhixiang memorialized to add Inspector-in-Chief of Works and Han prefecture military commissioner; he then remained garrisoned at Chengdu.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang had him made inspector of works and Han commissioner, then kept him at Chengdu.)〉

sentences.zh: 洋州上言，重開入蜀舊路三百餘里，比今官路較二十五程而近。

translations.literal: Yang prefecture reported reopening an old road into Shu of more than three hundred li, twenty-five stages closer than the present official road.
translations.idiomatic: Yang reported reopening a 300-li old Shu road twenty-five stages shorter than the official route.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，殿中少監石知訥貶憲州司戶，坐扇惑軍鎮也。

translations.literal: On guisi, Palace Domestic vice director Shi Zhine was demoted to Xian prefecture registrar, sitting for inciting military prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Shi Zhine was demoted to Xian registrar for stirring the armies.

sentences.zh: 北面副招討、宋州節度使王晏球以定州節度使王都反狀聞。

translations.literal: Northern deputy campaign commissioner and Song prefecture military commissioner Wang Yanqiu reported the rebellion of Ding prefecture military commissioner Wang Du.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanqiu reported Wang Du's rebellion at Ding.

sentences.zh: 庚子，製義武軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、太原王王都削奪官爵。

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict stripped Yiwu Army military commissioner, Inspector Grand Marshal, concurrent Minister-in-Chief, and Prince of Taiyuan Wang Du of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Mingzong stripped Wang Du of Yiwu commissionership, rank, and Taiyuan princedom.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以王晏球為北面行營招討使，知定州行軍州事；

translations.literal: On renyin, Wang Yanqiu was made northern campaign headquarters commissioner, knowing Ding prefecture field-army prefectural affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wang Yanqiu became northern campaign commissioner with Ding field command;

sentences.zh: 以滄州節度使兼北面行營馬軍都指揮使安審通為副招討使兼諸道馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Cang prefecture military commissioner and concurrent northern campaign horse-army commander-in-chief An Shentong was made deputy campaign commissioner with concurrent commander-in-chief of horse armies of every circuit;
translations.idiomatic: An Shentong of Cang became deputy commissioner and commander of all circuit horse armies;

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍蕭希甫兼判大理卿事。

translations.literal: Left Regular Attendant Xiao Xifu was given concurrent acting Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Xifu acted as director of judicial review.

sentences.zh: 西京奏，前樞密使張居翰卒。

translations.literal: The Western Capital reported that former Privy Commissioner Zhang Juhan had died.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang reported former privy commissioner Zhang Juhan had died.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳朔，回鶻可汗仁喻封順化可汗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi new moon: Uyghur khan Renyu was enfeoffed Shunhua khan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the fifth month Uyghur Khan Renyu was enfeoffed Shunhua khan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，鄴都留守、天雄軍節度使石敬瑭，河陽節度使趙延壽並加駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yedu regent and Tianxiong army military commissioner Shi Jingtang and Heyang military commissioner Zhao Yanshou were both made Imperial Son-in-law Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Shi Jingtang of Yedu and Tianxiong and Zhao Yanshou of Heyang were both made imperial son-in-law commandants.

sentences.zh: 以右僕射李琪為太子少傅。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Li Qi was made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi, Right Vice Director, became Crown Prince junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，沙州節度使曹義金加爵邑。

translations.literal: On xinhai Shazhou military commissioner Cao Yijin gained added noble rank and fief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Cao Yijin of Shazhou gained added rank and fief.

sentences.zh: 王晏球上言，收奪得定州北西二關城。

translations.literal: Wang Yanqiu memorialized that the northern and western passes of Ding had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanqiu reported the northern and western Ding passes recovered.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，湖南馬殷奏，二月中，大破淮寇二萬，生擒將士五百餘人。

translations.literal: On guichou Ma Yin of Hunan memorialized that in the second month he had routed twenty thousand Huai raiders and captured alive over five hundred officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Ma Yin of Hunan reported routing twenty thousand Huai raiders in the second month and capturing over five hundred alive.

sentences.zh: 中書上言：「諸道薦人，宜酌定員數。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized: "Recommendations of men from the circuits should fix quota numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: "Circuit recommendations should fix quotas.

sentences.zh: 今後節度使每年許薦二人，帶使相者許薦三人，團練、防禦使各一人，節度、觀察判官並聽旨授，書記已下即許隨府。

translations.literal: Hereafter military commissioners may recommend two yearly, those bearing commissioner-exequatur three, training and defense commissioners one each; circuit and surveillance aides await imperial order, secretaries and below may follow the headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners might recommend two yearly, those with exequatur three, training and defense commissioners one; circuit aides awaited orders, secretaries and below might follow headquarters.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 以六軍判官、尚書司封郎中史圭為右諫議大夫，充樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Six Armies aide and Ministry of Rites Seals Bureau director Shi Gui was made Right Remonstrator and Privy Council regular academician.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Gui—Six Armies aide and Seals Bureau director—became Right Remonstrator and Privy Council regular academician.

sentences.zh: 詔州縣官以三十月為考限，刺史以二十五月為限，以到任日為始。

translations.literal: An edict set thirty months as the review term for prefectural and county officials and twenty-five months for prefects, counting from the day of taking office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict set thirty-month reviews for prefectural and county officials and twenty-five for prefects from the day of arrival.

sentences.zh: 己未，幽州奏，契丹禿餒領二千騎西南趨定州。

translations.literal: On jiwei Youzhou reported that the Khitan Tulüei led two thousand horse southwest toward Ding.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Youzhou reported Khitan Tulüei leading two thousand horse toward Ding.

sentences.zh: 以前同州節度使盧質行兵部尚書，判太常卿事。

translations.literal: Former Tongzhou military commissioner Lu Zhi was made acting Minister of War and judged Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi, former Tong commissioner, became acting war minister and judged Court of Imperial Sacrifices affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以天雄軍節度副使、判興唐府事趙敬怡為樞密使。

translations.literal: On xinyou Tianxiong deputy military commissioner and Xingtang prefecture judge Zhao Jingyi was made Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zhao Jingyi—Tianxiong deputy commissioner and Xingtang judge—became Privy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「上柱國，勳之極也。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Supreme Pillar of State is the summit of merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Supreme Pillar of State is merit's summit.

sentences.zh: 近代已來，文臣官階稍高，便授柱國，歲月未深，便轉上柱國。

translations.literal: In recent times when civil officials rose slightly in rank they received Pillar of State; before long they became Supreme Pillar.
translations.idiomatic: Lately civil officials at slight promotion received Pillar of State and soon became Supreme Pillar.

sentences.zh: 武資初官，便授上柱國。

translations.literal: Military men at first appointment received Supreme Pillar.
translations.idiomatic: Military men at first appointment received Supreme Pillar.

sentences.zh: 今後凡加勳，先自武騎尉，十二轉方授上柱國，永作成規，不令逾越。

translations.literal: Hereafter all merit grants start from Martial Cavalry Commandant; twelve steps reach Supreme Pillar—let this be perpetual rule, none may skip.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter merit would start at Martial Cavalry Commandant and reach Supreme Pillar in twelve steps—perpetual rule, no skipping.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，鎮州奏，今月十八日，王師不利於新樂。

translations.literal: " On dingmao Zhenzhou reported that on the eighteenth of this month the royal army fared ill at Xinle.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao Zhen reported the royal army fared ill at Xinle on the eighteenth.

sentences.zh: 壬申，王晏球奏，今月二十一日，大破定州賊軍及契丹於曲陽，斬獲數千人，王都與托諾以數十騎復入於定州。

translations.literal: On renshen Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-first he had routed Ding rebels and Khitan at Quyang, beheaded and captured thousands; Wang Du and Tuonuo re-entered Ding with several dozen horse.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wang Yanqiu reported routing Ding rebels and Khitan at Quyang on the twenty-first with thousands slain or captured; Wang Du and Tuonuo re-entered Ding with dozens of horse.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，以右金吾上將軍毛璋為左金吾上將軍，以前安州節度使史敬鎔為右金吾上將軍，以前華州節度使劉彥琮為左武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao: Right Golden Guard senior general Mao Zhang was made Left Golden Guard senior general; former Anzhou military commissioner Shi Jingrong was made Right Golden Guard senior general; former Huazhou military commissioner Liu Yanqiong was made Left Martial Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the sixth month Mao Zhang became Left Golden Guard senior general; Shi Jingrong, former An commissioner, Right Golden Guard senior general; Liu Yanqiong, former Hua commissioner, Left Martial Guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，放內園鹿七頭於深山。

translations.literal: On renwu seven palace deer were released into deep mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu seven palace deer were released into the mountains.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，皇子故金槍指揮使、檢校左僕射從璟贈太保。

translations.literal: On yiyou the late prince, former Golden Spear commander and honorary Left Vice Director Congjing, was posthumously made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou late Prince Congjing—former Golden Spear commander and honorary Left Vice Director—was posthumously made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幽州趙德鈞奏，殺契丹千餘人於幽州東，獲馬六百匹。

translations.literal: On jichou Zhao Dejun of Youzhou reported over a thousand Khitan killed east of Youzhou and six hundred horses captured.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhao Dejun of You reported over a thousand Khitan killed east of You and six hundred horses taken.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宰臣馮道率百僚上表，請上尊號曰聖明神武文德恭孝皇帝，詔報不允。

translations.literal: On renchen Chancellor Feng Dao led the hundred officials in memorial asking that the honorific Sagely Bright Divine Martial Cultured Virtuous Reverent Filial Emperor be granted; an edict declined.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Feng Dao led officials asking the title Sagely Bright Divine Martial Cultured Virtuous Reverent Filial Emperor; Mingzong declined.

sentences.zh: 丙申，馮道等再上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: On bingshen Feng Dao and others again offered the honorific; it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Feng Dao and others again offered the honorific; again declined.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以西京副留守、知留守事張遵誨行京兆尹。

translations.literal: On wuxu Western Capital deputy regent and acting regent Zhang Zunhui was made acting Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhang Zunhui, Western Capital deputy regent, became acting Jingzhao prefect.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，詔故偽蜀主王衍追封順正公，以諸侯禮葬。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yisi: an edict posthumously enfeoffed the late false-Shu ruler Wang Yan as Duke of Rectification and buried him with feudatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the seventh month of autumn Mingzong posthumously enfeoffed late false-Shu ruler Wang Yan as Duke of Rectification with feudatory burial.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以前武信軍節度使李敬周為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingwu former Wuxin army military commissioner Li Jingzhou was made Binzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Jingzhou, former Wuxin commissioner, became Bin commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以滄州節度使安審通卒於師輟朝。

translations.literal: On dingwei court was suspended for mourning because Cangzhou military commissioner An Shengtong died on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei court mourned Cang commissioner An Shengtong's death on campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以朔方節度使韓洙卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On renzi court was suspended for mourning because Shuofang military commissioner Han Zhu died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi court mourned Shuofang commissioner Han Zhu's death.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，王晏球奏，六月二十二日進攻逆城，將士傷者三千人。

translations.literal: On renyin Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-second of the sixth month he attacked the rebel city; three thousand officers and men were wounded.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wang Yanqiu reported attacking the rebel city on the twenty-second of the sixth month with three thousand wounded.

sentences.zh: 時晏球知城中有備，未欲急攻，朱宏昭、張虔釗切於立功，促攻賊壘，晏球不得已而進兵，遂致傷痍者眾。

translations.literal: At the time Yanqiu knew the city was prepared and did not wish to press the attack; Zhu Hongzhao and Zhang Qianzhao, eager for merit, urged assault on the rebel ramparts; Yanqiu advanced against his will and thus many were wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Yanqiu knew the city was ready and held back; Zhu Hongzhao and Zhang Qianzhao pressed for assault; forced to advance, he suffered heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以太子少保李茂勳卒輟朝。

translations.literal: On guimao court was suspended for mourning because Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Maoxun died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao court mourned Crown Prince junior tutor Li Maoxun.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔弛曲禁，許民間自造，於秋苗上納征曲價，畝出五錢。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict relaxed the liquor monopoly and permitted private brewing; at autumn grain a monopoly tax of five cash per mu was to be paid.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Mingzong relaxed the liquor monopoly, allowed private brewing, and levied five cash per mu on autumn grain.

sentences.zh: 時孔循以曲法殺一家於洛陽，或獻此議，以為愛其人，便於國，故行之。

translations.literal: At the time Kong Xun had executed a household at Luoyang under the liquor law; someone offered this plan, holding that sparing the people would benefit the state—hence it was enacted.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Xun had executed a Luoyang household under the liquor law; someone proposed sparing the people for the state's good—and the edict followed.

sentences.zh: 宗正卿李紓除名，刑部侍郎馬縞貶綏州司馬，刑部員外郎李慎儀貶階州司戶。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Clan Li Shu was removed from office; Vice Minister of Punishments Ma Gao was demoted to Suizhou aide; Punishments bureau outer official Li Shenyi was demoted to Jiezhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Clan director Li Shu was struck from the rolls; Ma Gao, punishments vice minister, went to Suizhou aide; Li Shenyi, punishments outer official, to Jie registrar.

sentences.zh: 初，李紓差攝陵台令張保嗣等各虛稱試銜，為奉先令王延朗所訟，大理寺斷以詐假官論，刑部詳覆，稱非詐假。

translations.literal: Initially Li Shu had acting Mausoleum Platform director Zhang Baosi and others falsely claim trial titles; Fengxian magistrate Wang Yanlang sued them; the Court of Judicial Review judged it false appointment; the Ministry of Punishments on review held it was not false appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shu had Zhang Baosi and other acting mausoleum officials falsely claim trial titles; Wang Yanlang of Fengxian sued; Judicial Review judged false appointment; Punishments on review denied it.

sentences.zh: 大理執之，召兩司廷議，刑部理屈，故有是貶。

translations.literal: Judicial Review held to its judgment; both offices were summoned for court debate; Punishments lost—hence the demotions.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial Review held firm; both offices debated at court; Punishments lost—hence the demotions.

sentences.zh: 紓續敕配隴州，徒一年。

translations.literal: Shu was further by edict assigned to Longzhou and exiled one year.
translations.idiomatic: Shu was further assigned to Longzhou for one year's exile.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詔曰：「天下州府，例是攝官，皆結試銜，或因勘窮，便關詐假。

translations.literal: Before long an edict said: "Prefectures and counties everywhere are by rule acting officials, all claiming trial titles; some through investigation prove false.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict said prefectures and counties were acting officials who claimed trial titles, some proven false on investigation.

sentences.zh: 已前或有稱試銜，一切不問，此後並宜禁止。

translations.literal: If any before this claimed trial titles, all are not to be questioned; hereafter it is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Prior trial-title claims would not be pursued; hereafter they were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」曹州刺史成景宏貶綏州司戶參軍，續敕長流宥州，尋賜自盡，坐受本州倉吏錢百緡也。

translations.literal: " Caozhou prefect Cheng Jinghong was demoted to Suizhou registrar; by further edict he was long-streamed to Youzhou and soon ordered to kill himself—for taking one hundred strings from the prefectural granary clerks.
translations.idiomatic: " Caozhou prefect Cheng Jinghong was demoted to Su registrar, long-streamed to You, and ordered to kill himself for taking a hundred strings from granary clerks.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，齊州防禦使曹廷隱以奏舉失實，配流永州，續敕賜自盡。

translations.literal: On renxu Qizhou defense commissioner Cao Tingyin, for false memorial recommendation, was assigned to Yongzhou; by further edict he was ordered to kill himself.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Cao Tingyin of Qi, for false recommendation, was sent to Yong and ordered to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 甲子，王晏球奏，今月十九日契丹七千騎來援定州，王師逆戰於唐河北，大破之。

translations.literal: On jiazi Wang Yanqiu reported that on the nineteenth of this month seven thousand Khitan horse came to relieve Ding; the royal army met them on the north of the Tang River and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wang Yanqiu reported seven thousand Khitan relieving Ding on the nineteenth; the royal army routed them north of the Tang River.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （案：《通鑒》：壬戌，王晏球破契丹於唐河。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: On renxu Wang Yanqiu routed the Khitan at the Tang River.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says on renxu Wang Yanqiu routed the Khitan at the Tang River.)〉

sentences.zh: 追至滿城，又破之，斬二千級，獲馬千匹。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Mancheng he routed them again, beheaded two thousand, and captured a thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Mancheng he routed them again, beheading two thousand and taking a thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔福建節度使王延鈞可依前檢校太師、守中書令，進封閩王。

translations.literal: On wuchen an edict ordered Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun to remain honorary Grand Preceptor and acting Secretariat Director and advanced him to Prince of Min.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wang Yanjun of Fujian kept grand preceptor and acting director and was advanced to Prince of Min.

sentences.zh: 己巳，王晏球奏，此月二十一日，追契丹至易州，掩殺四十里，擒獲甚眾。

translations.literal: On jisi Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-first of this month he pursued the Khitan to Yizhou and slaughtered them for forty li, capturing many.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wang Yanqiu reported pursuing Khitan to Yi on the twenty-first and slaughtering them for forty li with many captured.

sentences.zh: 故朔方節度使韓洙贈太尉。

translations.literal: The late Shuofang military commissioner Han Zhu was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Late Shuofang commissioner Han Zhu was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎王權、御史中丞梁文矩並為吏部侍郎，以左諫議大夫呂夢奇為御史中丞。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Wang Quan and Censor-in-Chief Liang Wenju were both made Vice Ministers of Personnel; Left Remonstrator Lü Mengqi was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan of War and Liang Wenju, censor-in-chief, became personnel vice ministers; Lü Mengqi, Left Remonstrator, became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉朔，以翰林學士守中書舍人李懌、劉煦並為戶部侍郎充職，以吏部侍郎劉嶽守秘書監，以吏部侍郎韓彥惲守禮部尚書，以戶部侍郎歸藹守太子賓客，以戶部侍郎裴皞守兵部侍郎，以中書舍人張文寶守刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guiyou new moon: Hanlin academician and acting Secretariat drafting officer Li Yun and Liu Xu were both made Vice Ministers of Revenue in office; Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Yue acted as Director of the Imperial Library; Vice Minister of Personnel Han Yanhun acted as Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Revenue Gui Ai acted as Crown Prince Guest; Vice Minister of Revenue Pei Hao acted as Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer Zhang Wenbao acted as Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month Li Yun and Liu Xu, Hanlin academicians, became revenue vice ministers; Liu Yue of Personnel acted as library director; Han Yanhun of Personnel as rites minister; Gui Ai of Revenue as crown prince guest; Pei Hao of Revenue as war vice minister; Zhang Wenbao as punishments vice minister.

sentences.zh: 詔凡有姓犯廟諱者，以本望為姓。

translations.literal: An edict said that wherever a surname violated a temple taboo, the clan origin surname should be used.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said surnames violating temple taboos should revert to the clan origin surname.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以檢校尚書右僕射、守龍武大將軍劉訓為晉州節度使、檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On dingchou honorary Right Vice Director and acting Dragon Martial senior general Liu Xun was made Jinzhou military commissioner and honorary Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Liu Xun—honorary Right Vice Director and acting Dragon Martial senior general—became Jin commissioner and honorary grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幽州趙德鈞奏，於府西邀殺契丹敗黨數千人，生擒首領惕隱等五十餘人。

translations.literal: On renwu Zhao Dejun of Youzhou reported intercepting and killing several thousand fleeing Khitan west of the prefectural seat and capturing alive over fifty chieftains including Tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Zhao Dejun of You reported killing thousands of fleeing Khitan west of the city and capturing over fifty leaders including Tiyin.

sentences.zh: 是時，官軍襲殺契丹，屬秋雨繼降，泥濘莫進，人饑馬乏，散投村落，所在村民持白梃毆殺之。

translations.literal: At the time the royal army was pursuing and killing Khitan; continuous autumn rain made mud impassable; men starved and horses failed; scattered into villages, local people beat them to death with clubs.
translations.idiomatic: The royal army pursued Khitan while autumn rains made roads mud; men starved and horses failed; fugitives were clubbed in villages.

sentences.zh: 德鈞出兵接於要路，惟奇峰嶺北有馬潛遁脫者數十餘，無噍類。

translations.literal: Dejun sent troops to block the key route; only north of Qifeng Ridge did several dozen men escape on hidden horses—none survived.
translations.idiomatic: Dejun blocked the escape route; only north of Qifeng Ridge did a few dozen flee on hidden horses—none else survived.

sentences.zh: 帝致書諭其本國。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent a letter instructing their home country.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong sent a letter instructing their home country.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以朔方軍留後韓璞為朔方軍節度使、靈武雄警甘肅等州觀察使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On xinmao Shuofang army acting commissioner Han Pu was made Shuofang army military commissioner, Lingwu martial-alert Gansu and other prefectures surveillance commissioner, and honorary Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Han Pu, Shuofang acting commissioner, became Shuofang commissioner, Lingwu-Gansu surveillance commissioner, and honorary Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 帝聞隨、鄧、復、郢、均、房之民，父母骨肉有疾，以長竿遙致粥食而餉之，出嫁女，夫家不遣來省疾，乃下詔委長吏嚴加禁察。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard that among the people of Sui, Deng, Fu, E, Jun, and Fang, when parents or kin fell ill they sent gruel on long poles from afar; when married daughters' husbands' families would not let them visit the sick, he issued an edict ordering chief officials to forbid and investigate strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that in Sui, Deng, Fu, E, Jun, and Fang kin sent gruel on long poles when parents were ill, and husbands' families barred visiting daughters, Mingzong ordered strict investigation.

sentences.zh: 房州奏，新開山路四百里，南通夔州，畫圖以獻。

translations.literal: Fangzhou reported a new mountain road four hundred li opened, south connecting to Kuizhou; a map was presented.
translations.idiomatic: Fang reported a new four-hundred-li mountain road south to Kui and presented a map.

sentences.zh: 以前洋州節度使戴思遠為太子太保致仕。

translations.literal: Former Yangzhou military commissioner Dai Siyuan was made Crown Prince Grand Guardian and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Siyuan, former Yang commissioner, retired as Crown Prince grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔：「今後翰林學士入院，以先後為班次，承旨一員，不計官資先後，在學士之上。」

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict said: "Hereafter when Hanlin academicians enter the academy, order follows seniority; the drafting commissioner alone, regardless of office rank or seniority, precedes the academicians.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict said Hanlin entry order would follow seniority except the drafting commissioner, who precedes regardless of rank.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，兩浙節度觀察留後、清海軍節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令錢元瓘可杭州、越州大都督府長史，充鎮東、鎮海等軍節度使。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, dingwei: Liangzhe surveillance acting commissioner, Qinghai army military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Secretariat Director Qian Yuanguan was made chief administrator of Hang and Yue great prefectures and Zhendong and Zhenhai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the intercalary month Qian Yuanguan—Liangzhe surveillance acting commissioner, Qinghai commissioner, grand preceptor, and director—became Hang-Yue chief administrator and Zhendong-Zhenhai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，趙德鈞獻戎俘於闕下，其蕃將惕隱等五十人留於親衛，餘契丹六百人皆斬之。

translations.literal: On wushen Zhao Dejun presented barbarian captives at court; the barbarian general Tiyin and fifty others were kept in the personal guard; the remaining six hundred Khitan were all beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhao Dejun presented captives; Tiyin and fifty barbarian generals joined the personal guard; six hundred other Khitan were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，升楚州為順化軍。

translations.literal: On yimao Chuzhou was raised to Shunhua army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Chu was raised to Shunhua army.

sentences.zh: 以明州刺史錢元向為本州節度使，以吏部尚書蕭頃為太子少保。

translations.literal: Mingzhou military commissioner Qian Yuanxiang was made military commissioner of that prefecture; Minister of Personnel Xiao Xiang was made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanxiang of Ming became that circuit's commissioner; Xiao Xiang of Personnel became Crown Prince junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使來貢獻。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 契丹平州刺史張希崇上表歸順。

translations.literal: Khitan Pingzhou prefect Zhang Xichong submitted a memorial seeking allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan Ping prefect Zhang Xichong submitted allegiance.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，陝州節度使李從敏移鎮滄州。

translations.literal: On yichou Shaan military commissioner Li Congmin was transferred to Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Congmin of Shaan moved to Cang.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽南院使張延朗為陝州節度使。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant of the Southern Institute Zhang Yanlang was made Shaan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanlang, Southern Institute palace attendant, became Shaan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔：「在京遇行極法日，宜不舉樂，兼減常膳。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When capital punishment days occur in the capital, music should not be played and regular meals should be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "On capital punishment days in the capital, halt music and reduce meals.

sentences.zh: 諸州遇行極法日，禁聲樂。

translations.literal: When capital punishment days occur in the prefectures, music and voices are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefectures, forbid music on capital punishment days.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，滑州掌書記孟升匿母服，大理寺斷處流，特敕孟升賜自盡。

translations.literal: " On jisi Huazhou secretary Meng Sheng concealed mourning for his mother; the Court of Judicial Review sentenced exile; by special edict Meng Sheng was ordered to kill himself.
translations.idiomatic: " On jisi Meng Sheng, Huazhou secretary, concealed mourning; Judicial Review sentenced exile; a special edict ordered him to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 觀察使、觀察判官、錄事參軍朱其糾察，各行殿罰。

translations.literal: Surveillance commissioners, surveillance aides, and registrar Zhu Qi investigated and each received palace discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners, aides, and registrar Zhu Qi investigated and each was disciplined at court.

sentences.zh: 襄邑縣民聞威，父為人所殺，不雪父冤，有狀和解，特敕處死。

translations.literal: Xiangyi county man Wen Wei's father was killed by another but he did not avenge his father; though there was a petition to settle, by special edict he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Wei of Xiangyi did not avenge his father's killer though a settlement petition existed; a special edict ordered execution.

sentences.zh: 是月二十七，大水，河水溢。

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh of this month great floods; the Yellow River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh great floods overflowed the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 絳州地震。

translations.literal: Jiangzhou was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，以捧聖左右廂副都指揮使索自通為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yihai: Left and Right Bangsheng deputy overall commandant Suo Zitong was made Yunzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the ninth month Suo Zitong, Bangsheng deputy overall commandant, became Yun commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太府卿、判四方館事李鬱為宗正卿。

translations.literal: On dingchou Grand Storehouse Director and judge of the Four Directions Office Li Yu was made Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Yu—Grand Storehouse director and Four Directions Office judge—became Imperial Clan director.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以晉州節度使安崇阮為左驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On renwu Jinzhou military commissioner An Chongruan was made Left Martial Cavalry senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu An Chongruan of Jin became Left Martial Cavalry senior general.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吐蕃、回紇各遣使貢獻。

translations.literal: On jiashen Tibet and Huihe each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Tibet and Huihe each sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宰臣王建立進玉杯，上有文曰「傳國萬歲杯」。

translations.literal: On renchen Chancellor Wang Jianli presented a jade cup bearing the inscription "Cup of Ten Thousand Years for Transmitting the State."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Wang Jianli presented a jade cup inscribed "Cup of Ten Thousand Years for Transmitting the State."

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔德州流人溫韜、遼州流人段凝、嵐州司戶陶玘、憲州司戶石知訥、原州司馬聶嶼，並宜賜死於本處，暴其宿惡而誅之也。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict ordered exiles Wen Tao of Dezhou, Duan Ning of Liaozhou, Tao Qi registrar of Lanzhou, Shi Zhina registrar of Xianzhou, and Nie Yu aide of Yuanzhou—all should be granted death where they were, exposing their long-standing wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Mingzong ordered De exile Wen Tao, Liao exile Duan Ning, Lan registrar Tao Qi, Xian registrar Shi Zhina, and Yuan aide Nie Yu—all executed on the spot for long wickedness.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以邠州節度使梁漢顒為右威衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On bingshen Binzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong was made Right Martial Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Liang Hanyong of Bin became Right Martial Guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，河陽節度使、駙馬都尉趙延壽為檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On dingyou Heyang military commissioner and Imperial Son-in-law Commandant Zhao Yanshou was made honorary Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhao Yanshou of Heyang, imperial son-in-law commandant, became honorary Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔徐州節度使房知溫兼荊南行營招討使，知荊南行府事。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict made Xuzhou military commissioner Fang Zhiwen concurrent Jingnan campaign commissioner and charged with Jingnan headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Fang Zhiwen of Xu was made concurrent Jingnan campaign commissioner and charged with headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，製瓊華長公主孟氏可冊為福慶長公主。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiachen: Princess Qionghua of the Chang clan, née Meng, may be enfeoffed as Princess of Fuqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the tenth month of winter Princess Qionghua Meng was enfeoffed Princess of Fuqing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以滄州節度使李從敏兼北面招討使。

translations.literal: On bingwu Cangzhou military commissioner Li Congmin was made concurrent northern campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Congmin of Cang became concurrent northern campaign commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，帝臨軒，命禮部尚書韓彥惲、工部侍郎任讚往應州奉冊四廟。

translations.literal: On wushen the Emperor held audience; he ordered Minister of Rites Han Yanhun and Vice Minister of Works Ren Zan to proceed to Yingzhou to conduct investiture at the four temples.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Mingzong held audience and ordered Han Yanhun of Rites and Ren Zan of Works to Ying for four-temple investiture.

sentences.zh: 詔邠州節度使李敬周攻慶州，以刺史竇廷琬拒命故也。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Binzhou military commissioner Li Jingzhou to attack Qingzhou because prefect Dou Tingwan had defied orders.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Li Jingzhou of Bin to attack Qing because prefect Dou Tingwan had defied orders.

sentences.zh: 戊午，契丹平州刺史張希崇已下八十餘人見於元德殿，頒賜有差。

translations.literal: On wuwu over eighty men including Khitan Pingzhou prefect Zhang Xichong appeared at Yuande Hall; rewards were graded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu over eighty men including Zhang Xichong of Khitan Ping appeared at Yuande Hall with graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 突厥首領張慕進等來朝貢。

translations.literal: Turkic chieftain Zhang Mujin and others came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Turkic chief Zhang Mujin and others came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，安州節度使高行珪奏，屯駐左神捷、左懷順軍士作亂，已逐殺出城。

translations.literal: On jiazi Anzhou military commissioner Gao Xinggui reported that garrisoned Left Divine Swift and Left Huaihun troops had mutinied and had been driven out and killed beyond the walls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Gao Xinggui of An reported Left Divine Swift and Left Huaihun garrison mutiny driven out and killed beyond the walls.

sentences.zh: 詔升壽州為忠正軍。

translations.literal: An edict raised Shouzhou to Zhongzheng army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict raised Shou to Zhongzheng army.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以雲州節度使索自通領壽州節度使，以前雲州節度使張溫復為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Yunzhou military commissioner Suo Zitong took concurrent Shouzhou military commissioner; former Yunzhou military commissioner Zhang Wen was restored as Yun military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Suo Zitong of Yun also took Shou; Zhang Wen, former Yun commissioner, was restored at Yun.

sentences.zh: 庚午夜，西南有彗星長丈餘，在牛星五度。

translations.literal: At midnight on gengzi a comet over a zhang long appeared southwest in the fifth degree of the Ox constellation.
translations.idiomatic: At gengzi midnight a comet over a zhang appeared southwest in the fifth degree of the Ox.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guiyou: at the winter solstice the Emperor held audience at Chongyuan Hall and received congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the eleventh month Mingzong received winter-solstice congratulations at Chongyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，捧聖指揮使何福進招收到安州作亂兵士五百人，自指揮使已下至節級四十餘人並斬，餘眾釋之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Bangsheng commander He Fujin rounded up five hundred mutinous troops from Anzhou; from commander down to section leader over forty were beheaded and the rest released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu He Fujin of Bangsheng rounded up five hundred An mutineers; over forty from commander to section leader were beheaded and the rest released.

sentences.zh: 壬午，房知溫奏，荊南高季興卒。

translations.literal: On renwu Fang Zhiwen reported that Jingnan's Gao Jixing had died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Fang Zhiwen reported Gao Jixing of Jingnan had died.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人劉讚奏：「請節度使及文班三品已上謝見通喚。

translations.literal: Secretariat drafting officer Liu Zan memorialized: "We ask that military commissioners and civil officials of third rank and above at their farewell audience be summoned by announcement.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zan, Secretariat drafting officer, asked that commissioners and civil officials of third rank and above be summoned by announcement at farewell audience.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 是日，以契丹所署平州刺史、光祿大夫、檢校太保張希崇為汝州刺史，加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: That same day Zhang Xichong, whom the Khitan had appointed Pingzhou prefect, Grand Guardian, and Grand Preceptor by inspection, was made Ruzhou prefect and additionally Grand Tutor by inspection.
translations.idiomatic: That day Zhang Xichong—Khitan-appointed at Ping, grand guardian and grand preceptor by inspection—became Ru prefect and grand tutor by inspection.

sentences.zh: 己丑，中書奏：「今後或有封冊，請禦正衙。

translations.literal: On jichou the Central Secretariat memorialized: "Whenever there are investitures or enfeoffments hereafter, we ask that they be conducted at the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the Secretariat asked that future investitures and enfeoffments be held at the main hall.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 青州奏，節度使霍彥威卒，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: Qingzhou reported that military commissioner Huo Yanwei had died; court was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: Qing reported commissioner Huo Yanwei had died; court was suspended three days.

sentences.zh: 詔宰臣王建立權知青州軍州事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chancellor Wang Jianli to act as Qingzhou military and civil commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Wang Jianli acting Qing commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，禮部員外郎和凝奏：「應補齋郎並須引驗正身，以防偽濫。

translations.literal: On gengyin Vice Director of Rites He Ning memorialized: "All candidates for zhaolang office must be led forward to verify the person in the flesh, to guard against fraud and abuse.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin He Ning of Rites asked that zhaolang candidates be verified in person to prevent fraud.

sentences.zh: 舊例，使蔭一任官補一人，今後改官須轉品即可，如無子，許以親侄繼限，念書十卷，試可則補。

translations.literal: By old precedent one office in the envoy's hereditary privilege granted one appointee; hereafter when the post changes rank a corresponding rank transfer suffices; if there is no son, a nephew within the kin quota may succeed; having recited ten scrolls, if he passes the test he may be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: By old rule one privileged office yielded one appointee; hereafter rank change required rank transfer; without a son a nephew in the kin quota might succeed after reciting ten scrolls and passing the test.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以尚書左僕射、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、判三司王建立為青州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事。

translations.literal: On jiawu Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, co-equal councilor, Director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and Commissioner of the Three Bureaus Wang Jianli was made Qingzhou military commissioner, Grand Preceptor by inspection, and co-equal councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Jianli—left vice director, councilor, Hall of Assembled Worthies director, and Three Bureaus commissioner—became Qing commissioner, grand preceptor by inspection, and councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，帝謂侍臣曰：「古鐵券如何？

translations.literal: On bingshen the Emperor said to those beside him: "What of the ancient iron certificates of mercy?"
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Mingzong asked attendants: "What of the ancient iron certificates of mercy?"

sentences.zh: 」趙鳳對曰：「帝王誓文，許其子子孫孫長享爵祿。

translations.literal: Zhao Feng replied: "They are a sovereign's sworn text, granting that his sons and grandsons long enjoy rank and stipend."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng said they were a ruler's oath granting sons and grandsons lasting rank and stipend.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「先朝所賜，惟朕與郭崇韜、李繼麟三人爾，崇韜、繼麟尋已族滅，朕之危疑，慮在旦夕。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Those bestowed by the former reign are only for me and Guo Chongtao and Li Jilin—the three of us. Chongtao and Jilin were soon extirpated root and branch; my own peril and doubt I fear come any morning or evening."
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said only he, Guo Chongtao, and Li Jilin had received them from the prior reign—and Chongtao and Jilin were soon wiped out; his own peril might come any day.

sentences.zh: 」於是嗟歎久之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he sighed at length.
translations.idiomatic: He sighed at length.

sentences.zh: 趙鳳曰：「帝王執信，故不必銘金鏤石矣。

translations.literal: Zhao Feng said: "A ruler who holds faith need not inscribe it in gold and carve it in stone."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng said a faithful ruler need not inscribe gold or carve stone.

sentences.zh: 」吏部郎中何澤奏：「流外官請不試書判之類。

translations.literal: Vice Director of Personnel He Ze memorialized: "We ask that stream-outside officials be exempt from testing document judgments and the like.
translations.idiomatic: He Ze of Personnel asked that stream-outside officials be exempt from document-judgment tests.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tibet sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，前安州節度副使範延榮並男皆斬於軍巡獄，為高行珪誣奏故也。

translations.literal: On wuxu former Anzhou deputy military commissioner Fan Yanrong and his son were both beheaded in the military patrol prison—for Gao Xinggui's false memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Fan Yanrong, former An deputy commissioner, and his son were beheaded in the patrol prison for Gao Xinggui's false report.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅朔，詔真定府屬縣宜準河中、鳳翔例升為次畿，真定縣升為次赤。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renyin new moon: an edict said the counties subordinate to Zhending prefecture should follow the precedent of Hezhong and Fengxiang and be raised to secondary metropolitan dependencies; Zhending county was raised to secondary imperial capital rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the twelfth month an edict raised Zhending's counties to secondary metropolitan rank as at Hezhong and Fengxiang, and Zhending county to secondary imperial capital rank.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，邠州節度使李敬周奏，收下慶州，刺史竇廷琬族誅。

translations.literal: On jiachen Binzhou military commissioner Li Jingzhou reported that Qing prefecture had been taken; prefect Dou Tingwan's clan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Jingzhou of Bin reported Qing had fallen; prefect Dou Tingwan's clan was executed.
